summary: Pampa Energía S.A. filed a Form 6-K on May 8, 2026, furnishing its unaudited consolidated condensed interim financial statements for the three-month period ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes a review report from Price Waterhouse Co. S.R.L. stating no material misstatements, along with forward-looking statements. This is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer under the 1934 Act, not a special-situation event. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation elements. The filing simply meets ongoing disclosure obligations with no transaction-related disclosure.
